title: As Luke Fights
section: The Comic Art of Star Wars
description: As Luke fights the reborn Emperor, the evil master unleashes a cataclysmic energy storm (front, cover by Dave Dorman) in the final installment of DARK EMPIRE written by Tom Veitch for Dark Horse Comics. Only Leia can pull her brother back from the abyss and, together, challenge the Emperor. His fate is shown (back) by series artist Cam Kennedy with powerful illustrations.
